place.name: Kitzbühel
place.description: Kitzbühel (German: [ˈkɪtsbyːl] or [ˈkɪtsbyːəl] ; Bavarian: Kitzbiché [ˈkxɪtspɪxɪ]) is a medieval town situated in the Kitzbühel Alps along the river Kitzbüheler Ache in Tyrol, Austria, about 100 km (62 mi) east of the state capital Innsbruck, and is the administrative centre of the Kitzbühel District (Bezirk). Kitzbühel is one of the most famous and exclusive ski resorts in the world and is frequented by the international high society.
